_comment: run_26 = run_25 (ideal-free settlement, block 3) + AGE-SPECIFIC DEPARTURE (dispersal_departure.form = age): a logit offset on adult departure (breeding dispersal; prior N(-2, 1.5)) on top of the shared density-dependent curve.

Why: E008 found departure strongly NEGATIVELY density-dependent (87% at N/K=0, 1% at 0.8) -- read as the single age-blind curve buying adult site fidelity in cores. If adults can be sticky on their own, the shared slope should relax (research/age_model, E012).
